Do you have a strong background in electrical and mechanical maintenance and would you like to work with advanced logistics systems? Then this could be your next opportunity. For ASML Technical Support – Warehouse, we are looking for a Service Technician to strengthen the team. In this role, you will help ensure the optimal operation, availability, and reliability of automated warehouse systems and intralogistics equipment. You will work in a high-tech environment where automation, precision, safety, and continuous improvement are essential. Together with your colleagues, you will make sure that ASML's logistics operations continue to run efficiently and with minimal downtime. Wie zoeken we? You are a hands-on technician who enjoys working in a dynamic and highly automated environment. You approach technical problems in a structured way and remain calm when equipment unexpectedly stops or priorities change. Rather than simply solving the immediate issue, you look for the underlying cause and consider how similar problems can be prevented in the future. Because you will work closely with internal and external customers, colleagues, and suppliers, clear communication is essential. You are able to explain technical issues in an understandable way and understand the importance of good service. You take ownership of your responsibilities, work well as part of a team, and are always looking for ways to improve processes and equipment. Practical knowledge of electrical, mechanical, and pneumatic systems. Ability to read and

interpret electrical circuit diagrams and technical assembly drawings. Demonstrated experience with troubleshooting and fault finding. Experience with preventive and corrective maintenance. Experience with predictive maintenance and/or automated systems is an advantage. Strong awareness of safety and quality standards. Good command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken. Wat bieden wij je? As a Service Technician at ASML, you will work in a highly automated and technologically advanced environment where you can further develop your technical expertise. You will have the opportunity to work with complex equipment, learn from experienced colleagues, and build a long-term career within one of the world's leading high-tech companies. An annual bonus based on company results. 27 days of paid annual leave. Long-term career and development opportunities. The opportunity to work with advanced automated systems in a high-tech environment. Be Part of the Impact ASML develops and manufactures the world's most advanced lithography systems. These systems are essential for producing the microchips that power modern technology. Behind this highly complex production process is a sophisticated logistics operation that ensures the right components and materials are available at the right place and at the right time. As a Service Technician, you are an essential part of that operation. By keeping automated warehouse systems and intralogistics equipment running reliably, you directly contribute to the continuity of ASML's production process. Your work may happen behind the scenes, but its impact is significant: you help keep the technology of tomorrow moving today.  Wat ga je doen? 
As a part-time mail carrier at PostNL in Sevenum, you make sure everyone receives their mail on time. You can organise your own schedule, which makes this job very flexible. 
Your day starts at the depot in your neighbourhood, where you collect the mail for your route. You sort the letters and get your bike ready. Then you're ready to go! You will be working at PostNL, the largest postal and parcel company in the Netherlands. Every day, they ensure that millions of letters and parcels are delivered to the right destination, both within the Netherlands and abroad.
